ulurp_197c.borough_president_review.effect: Submits a written recommendation or waiver to the City Planning Commission; the recommendation is advisory, not binding.

ulurp_197c.mayoral_review.effect: May file a written disapproval or objection where the Charter provides; this profile does not infer that one occurred.
